## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon, macOS 15 or later) | `SubtitleMirror-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| **Windows** (64-bit, Windows 10 or later) | `SubtitleMirror-windows-x64-setup.exe` |

Linux: use the command-line version; see the README.

**Mac:** open the `.dmg` and drag Subtitle Mirror into Applications.

**Windows:** run the installer. If Windows says it "protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**. The first time you play a video, allow Subtitle Mirror through the firewall on **Private networks**.

Then open Subtitle Mirror, drop a video on it, and scan the QR code with your phone.

---

The app includes mpv and FFmpeg, which are GPL-licensed; see [THIRD_PARTY.md](https://github.com/sujitv19196/subtitle-mirror-enlarge/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY.md) for versions and source links.
